column1: # Your own reads -- one sample per line, tab-separated.
#   sample   name used for all of this sample's outputs (letters, digits, _ or -)
#   fastq_1  reads (or read 1 of a pair); .fastq or .fastq.gz
#   fastq_2  read 2 of a pair; leave empty for single-end reads
# Relative paths are relative to the repository root. Lines starting with #
# are ignored. Point `samples:` in config.yaml (or your own config) at a copy.
